passages.S06.title: S06 · Yoruba traditional wedding (engagement), bride
passages.S06.context: She is 28, from Lagos. This is her traditional ceremony. The white wedding is the following week. She wants to look regal.
passages.S06-D: An aso-oke buba with a premium Ankara wrapper in a different colour, a gele, and gold jewellery.
